verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official CLI. It is documented at firebase.google.com/docs/cli, and the official firebase/firebase-tools repo shows it deploying code and assets, running a local Hosting server, interacting with database data and importing/exporting Auth users. One-command deploys for Cloud Functions are also documented. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI features (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive or CI auth modes, documented use by AI agents), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in AI-native workflows.
